summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. (NYSE/TSX: TFPM) filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its wholly owned subsidiary's acquisition of a US$440 million gold stream on the producing Ravenswood Gold Mine in Queensland, Australia. The stream was previously disclosed in a June 12, 2026 news release. First gold delivery is expected in Q3 2026. The company increased its 2030 outlook to 150,000-160,000 GEOs. No financial terms (price per share, premium) are applicable as this is a streaming agreement, not an equity transaction. As a Canadian issuer, the 6-K furnishes the announcement to the SEC. Watch for operational updates on Ravenswood's ramp-up to ~200,000 oz gold per annum by 2028.
